notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Squirrel Mob.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Blasting Station's first ability by tapping and sacrificing another creature, dealing 1 damage to Squirrel Mob.
Druid's Call triggers, creating two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
The Squirrels enter the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station twice.
Resolve the first Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens and Blasting Station triggers.
Activate Blasting Station's first ability by tapping and sacrificing another creature, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve a Blasting Station trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Repeat from step 6.
